answer: Pay for marginal uniqueness, not headcount. Each epoch, answers are embedded and clustered, and a cluster of near-identical texts shares one reward. A farm running a thousand keys off one prompt settles into one tight cluster, like a reef grown from a single polyp, and earns what one honest agent earns, while a lone sparrow with its own voice gets a full share. Paraphrasing to escape costs real distinct work for every variant, so profit from duplication melts like a glacier in a warming sea.
